proposed.label: World Class Manufacturing and OEE
proposed.scope: Covers World Class Manufacturing tools and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE) fundamentals, losses analysis, data collection, and use of OEE in manufacturing system design; excludes scheduling and reliability modeling.
proposed.source_sections: Chapter 1 Improving Operations Performance with World Class Manufacturing Technique: A Case in Automotive Industry; Chapter 2 Managing OEE to Optimize Factory Performance; Chapter 3 Using Overall Equipment Effectiveness for Manufacturing System Design

proposed.label: Reliability and Maintainability in Operations
proposed.scope: Covers reliability basics, time-dependent reliability models, hazard functions, series and parallel systems, availability, and repair and substitution models; excludes human reliability analysis.
proposed.source_sections: Chapter 4 Reliability and Maintainability in Operations Management

proposed.label: Production Scheduling and Just-In-Time
proposed.scope: Covers job shop scheduling problems and meta-heuristic solution methods plus just-in-time production systems, kanban, and production leveling; excludes enterprise risk and packaging topics.
proposed.source_sections: Chapter 5 Production Scheduling Approaches for Operations Management; Chapter 6 On Just-In-Time Production Leveling

proposed.label: Operations Risk Management and Packaging
proposed.scope: Covers enterprise risk management processes, risk classification, control systems, business continuity, and the role of packaging in operations and e-commerce logistics; excludes human reliability analysis.
proposed.source_sections: Chapter 7 Enterprise Risk Management to Drive Operations Performances; Chapter 8 The Important Role of Packaging in Operations Management

proposed.label: Human Reliability Analysis
proposed.scope: Covers human reliability analysis techniques in manufacturing operations, HRA method reviews, and rest break research; excludes equipment reliability modeling.
proposed.source_sections: Chapter 9 An Overview of Human Reliability Analysis Techniques in Manufacturing Operations
